description: Powerfill is a South Korean poly-D,L-lactic acid (PDLLA) collagen biostimulator from Regen Biotech, supplied as a 1000 mg lyophilised powder for reconstitution. It is positioned for larger-area and body contouring where gradual, natural-looking volume restoration is required. Rather than acting as an instant filler, it drives the patient's own collagen synthesis over the following weeks and months.
howItWorks: Once reconstituted and injected, the PDLLA microspheres act as a biocompatible scaffold that provokes a controlled fibroblast response, prompting deposition of new type I and III collagen. The carrier gel is resorbed within weeks while the collagen matrix continues to build, producing progressive volume and dermal thickening. Full results develop over a multi-session course as neocollagenesis matures.
composition: Poly-D,L-lactic acid (PDLLA) microspheres, 1000 mg lyophilised powder per vial, with sodium carboxymethylcellulose (CMC); reconstituted before use.
usageNotes: Reconstitute the lyophilised powder with sterile water and allow adequate hydration time before injection. Inject into the deep dermis or subcutaneous plane; avoid superficial placement. Massage after treatment to distribute product evenly. Results build over weeks to months and a multi-session protocol is typical.

High 1000 mg payload suited to larger areas and body contouring

Decolletage and other broad rejuvenation areas
Overall skin quality and dermal thickening

description: Richesse PLA is a polylactic acid (PLA/PLLA) collagen biostimulator from the Korean aesthetics brand JDBIO, formulated with roughly 200 mg of PLA plus carboxymethylcellulose per vial. Marketed as a biodegradable stimulator for gradual volume enhancement, its effect is generated through neocollagenesis and is reported to last well over a year. It is intended for mid-face volumisation and treatment of laxity.
howItWorks: The PLA microparticles function as a resorbable scaffold that provokes a measured fibroblast response, stimulating new collagen deposition in the dermis. The carrier gel is absorbed while the newly formed collagen provides sustained, natural volume. Results appear gradually over the weeks following each session and accumulate across a treatment course.
composition: Polylactic acid (PLA/PLLA), approximately 200 mg with sodium carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) per vial; PLA derived from renewable plant-starch sources.
usageNotes: Reconstitute and hydrate per manufacturer instructions before use. Inject into the deep dermis or subcutaneous plane and massage to distribute evenly. Effect develops progressively over weeks; a course of sessions spaced roughly a month apart is typical, with volumising effect reported to last 18 months or more.

description: Olidia is a Korean poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) collagen biostimulator supplied as a 365 mg lyophilised vial (150 mg PLLA with CMC and mannitol carriers), manufactured by PRP Life Science. It restores facial volume and improves skin texture by stimulating the patient's own collagen. Being fully synthetic, it does not require pre-treatment allergy testing.
howItWorks: The PLLA microparticles act as a scaffold that stimulates fibroblasts to produce new type I collagen. The CMC and mannitol carrier provides some immediate correction and is resorbed within weeks, after which accumulating collagen delivers gradual, longer-lasting volume. Collagen deposition typically peaks around 6 to 8 weeks and builds cumulatively over a multi-session protocol.
composition: Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA), 365 mg/vial total (150 mg PLLA with 90 mg sodium carboxymethylcellulose and 125 mg mannitol as carrier/stabiliser); lyophilised powder reconstituted before use. Note: some distributor listings alternatively describe PDLLA/PCL microspheres.
usageNotes: Reconstitute and allow hydration before injection. Place into the deep dermis or subcutaneous plane and massage to distribute. A typical protocol is three sessions at roughly one-month intervals, with results building over the weeks after each session and reported to last 24+ months.

description: Power Col-Tra is a Korean poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) collagen biostimulator containing 365 mg of highly purified PLLA per vial, produced with StunMedical's solvent-free (non-solvent) manufacturing technology. It is designed for deep injection into the SMAS layer to stimulate the body's own collagen and restore structure, density and lift. Results build gradually and are reported to last over two years.
howItWorks: The porous PLLA microspheres (approximately 20 to 80 microns) act as a scaffold that activates fibroblasts, driving new collagen production in the deep tissue and SMAS plane. Volume and skin density increase progressively as collagen replaces the resorbed carrier, producing a subtle, natural lift rather than an instant fill.
composition: Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA), 365 mg/vial, as porous microspheres (~20 to 80 microns); non-animal-based and manufactured free of organic solvents; reconstituted before use.
usageNotes: Reconstitute and hydrate before use. Inject into the deep dermis, subcutaneous or SMAS plane per indication and massage to distribute. Effect develops over weeks to months across a multi-session course, with volume reported to last over two years.

It works by stimulating new type I and III collagen in the deep dermis to build progressive volume, elasticity and hydration.
howItWorks: PLLA microparticles (reported 20 to 80 microns) act as a biostimulatory scaffold, inducing fibroblasts to synthesise fresh type I and III collagen in the deep dermis. This rebuilds the skin's structural framework over successive weeks, with visible plumping and texture improvement typically noted within about three months.

description: PCL Power Booster is a Korean polycaprolactone (PCL) collagen-stimulating booster from StunMedical, supplied ready-to-use as a 2 mL vial of approximately 20% PCL solution. Unlike microsphere fillers it is a liquid biostimulator with no microparticles, forming a stable three-dimensional matrix in the tissue. It builds collagen and elastin over a treatment course for firmer, better-quality skin.
howItWorks: The polycaprolactone nanoparticles in solution create a stable three-dimensional matrix that gradually stimulates fibroblasts to produce new collagen and elastin. Because it is a liquid without microspheres, it spreads evenly through the tissue and improves overall skin density and elasticity progressively rather than adding instant volume.
composition: Approximately 20% polycaprolactone (PCL) solution, 2 mL per vial; ready-to-use liquid with no microparticles; PCL is a biodegradable, biocompatible polymer.
usageNotes: Ready-to-use with no reconstitution required. Inject into the dermis; suitable for face, neck, decolletage and hands. Results build over a course of typically several sessions spaced 3 to 4 weeks apart, with effect reported to last over a year. Maintenance sessions extend results.

description: Dr PCL is a polycaprolactone (PCL)-based collagen stimulator injectable. A specific manufacturer or authoritative product page could not be verified, so the brand is left null. As a PCL biostimulator it is designed to prompt gradual, long-lasting collagen formation for improved skin firmness and quality.
howItWorks: Polycaprolactone is a slow-degrading, biocompatible polymer. Whether delivered as microspheres in a carrier gel or as a liquid, it stimulates fibroblasts to lay down new collagen over an extended period. Because PCL resorbs more slowly than PLLA, its collagen-stimulating and volumising effect is typically sustained for a longer duration.

description: Radiesse is a calcium hydroxylapatite (CaHA) dermal filler and collagen biostimulator manufactured by Merz Aesthetics. It consists of CaHA microspheres suspended in an aqueous carboxymethylcellulose gel, delivering immediate volume together with progressive collagen stimulation. It is widely used for facial contouring and carries FDA-approved indications including moderate-to-severe facial folds, jawline contour and hand augmentation.
howItWorks: Radiesse works through two mechanisms. The carboxymethylcellulose gel provides immediate volume correction on injection, while the CaHA microspheres act as a scaffold that stimulates fibroblasts to produce new type I and III collagen, elastin and neovascularisation over the following weeks and months. As the gel carrier is resorbed, the newly generated collagen sustains the corrective and skin-quality effect.
composition: 30% synthetic calcium hydroxylapatite (CaHA) microspheres (25 to 45 microns) suspended in a 70% aqueous carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) gel carrier (sterile water, glycerin, sodium carboxymethylcellulose).
usageNotes: Supplied ready-to-use and can be diluted or hyperdiluted for skin biostimulation and hand treatment. Inject into the deep dermis, subdermal or supraperiosteal plane depending on indication and massage to mould. Not indicated for lip augmentation. Provides immediate volume with additional collagen-driven improvement that builds over weeks to months.
